metadata.name: angle-pivotality-diagnostic-100x199
metadata.intent: Diagnostic for `diagnose-angle-null-pivotality`: measure whether each replicate's RRPP permutation null moves with its own observed statistic. Three cells at effect 1.00 — orientation (the power shortfall), translation (the null control that behaved normally), magnitude (the comparator whose statistic reached power 1.00) — with every generator, integration, and evaluation parameter matching phase4_pilot_100x199.json.
notes: This is a one-question diagnostic, not a power study. Acceptance targets and the Phase 5 gate are disabled: the deliverable is the pivotality analysis over the per-replicate null summaries, not a rejection-rate verdict.

Only effect 1.00 is enumerated, so there is no zero-effect anchor to share; matched seeds still pair the three primary cells at each replicate index, sharing group A's baseline indicator draw and the within-stage group assignment. The cells are not otherwise identical draws: each mode's transform consumes a different amount of RNG, so sampled values downstream of the transform differ across modes.
Attribution diagnostics are off: they answer a different question (which features drive orientation) and cost time this diagnostic does not need.

Everything else is held at the Phase 4 pilot values on purpose — the target of the diagnostic is the Phase 4 behavior itself, so changing the permutation count or sample size would explain a different configuration.
